Joe and the guys were super friendly and honest. I was in a bind and from out of town. They worked with me and prioritized my vehicle and offered every solution and allowed me to make an informed decision. Their level of workmanship is great. Solid work and customer care. I will recommend them to everyone. And should I ever need service again I will drive the 50 miles just to use this shop again because of the trust they instilled in me.

Great customer service. Honest and good people. I was passing through from out of town and my car broke down. I knew nothing about shops in area and I thank God I found this place. They were upfront and honest about everything every step of the way. They didn’t try to cheat me or overcharge me because I was in a bind. They even did extra work I wasn’t charged for or even really mentioned. I have since brought my car back and received the same great service. I have even been able to call and ask their opinion about something another shop states my car needs or even price of work. They are so helpful and have really been pleasant in a tough and sometimes costly situation. I’m grateful and will continue to be a customer.
